summary: Lines 1-1500 of self_organize.py are the configuration spine of the whole system: a 328-entry knob registry (`_SPEC`, lines 96-513), the three accessors that read it (`_env`/`_i`/`_f`, lines 515-526) plus a deliberately-separate audit reader (`_cfg`, line 51), the module-level materialisation of ~115 of those knobs into globals, the corpus/held-out split and tokenizer bring-up under `DATA_MODE=real` (lines 1102-1312), the phase-schedule generator and stream builder (lines 1317-1412), and the model classes `ByteComposer`/`MiniLM`/`TinyTransformer` (1437-1600). The registry exists because five knobs previously had different defaults at different read sites; `_env` now raises SystemExit when a call-site default disagrees with the table (line 520), and `levers.py` re-derives the declaration/derivation sets from the AST so the table cannot silently go stale. Nine knobs are exempt because their default is an expression (`_DERIVED`, lines 84-94), and `_SPEC_FREE` is exactly that set. The region is unusually well-instrumented against its own failure modes -- `frozen_rng` (1019), `_srng` (1375), `pin_tick` (930), `_curve_by_step` (879) each exist because a specific silent-wrong-number bug shipped. The remaining defects are almost all of the project's own named classes: values that are declared but unreachable on the default path (FAB_MIN_STEPS=2, TOK_ANCHOR_TAU, MERGE_FRAC, GROW_PASSES), quantities computed in one unit and consumed as another (`PHASE_W` follows the PROCESS count while the registry says PHASES; `true_sw` is segment starts but is printed as "true switches"), and module globals that exist only down the `DATA_MODE=real` branch while being read unguarded later (`DISK_STREAM`). The default configuration as declared is not runnable: TOKENIZER=1 and DATA_MODE=synthetic contradict each other and a bare `python3 self_organize.py` exits at line 1104.

levers.name: DEVICE
levers.effect: torch device string used for every .to(dev); also gates the AMP branch.

levers.name: VERIFY
levers.effect: 'selfcon' (old B self-consistency) or 'recon' (Reconstructor-based verification) for the memory store.

levers.name: RECON_W
levers.effect: weight on joint Reconstructor training during the loop; 0 = post-hoc fit only (VERIFY_FIT).

levers.name: VERIFY_SWEEP
levers.effect: under VERIFY=recon, also DELETE unverified entries rather than only flagging them.

levers.name: D_MODEL
levers.effect: model width D. Default is D_MODEL_B (an alias, not a coupling).

levers.name: D_MODEL_B
levers.effect: the alias name every launcher/doc uses; read eagerly as D_MODEL's default so a direct D_MODEL_B=768 invocation no longer silently runs at 128.

levers.name: N_PROCESSES
levers.effect: number of synthetic Markov processes. Overwritten by len(CORP) on the real path, so it does nothing under DATA_MODE=real.
levers.owner: registry says misc; is a data knob

levers.name: STREAM_LEN
levers.effect: bytes/tokens per epoch of stream; divided by len(PHASE_SCHED) to size each phase.

levers.name: WIN
levers.effect: training/eval window width; also sizes ENC_POS_MAX's default (2*WIN) and the boundary-detection tolerance (WIN*2 or WIN*3).

levers.name: NEW_DIST
levers.effect: distance beyond which a window spawns a new domain; also the base of the merge fallback MERGE_FRAC*NEW_DIST.

levers.name: SHIFT_DIST
levers.effect: absolute adjacent-signature jump that counts as a boundary; superseded by SHIFT_REL's relative rule when that is on.

levers.name: SUSTAIN
levers.effect: consecutive over-threshold observations required before a boundary is declared.

levers.name: SIG_D
levers.effect: signature embedding dimension; also the sqrt(SIG_D) rescale the VICReg variance hinge needs for L2-normalised outputs.

levers.name: SIG_DIM
levers.effect: width of the frozen random projection / signature feature space.

levers.name: SIG_MODE
levers.effect: 'learned' (online InfoNCE encoder, the product path) or 'bigram'/'unigram' frozen byte-statistic baselines; gates whether contrastive_step runs at all.

levers.name: SELF_ORG
levers.effect: 0 disables domain self-assembly entirely (one bucket, no provenance, no management). Does NOT remove the SigEncoder, which also feeds fabric routing.

levers.name: ENC_BATCH
levers.effect: InfoNCE batch size; also the minimum viable anchor range ('if hi < ENC_BATCH: return') and the ln(ENC_BATCH) collapse loss value.

levers.name: ENC_EVERY
levers.effect: encoder cadence near a boundary; also the parent of ENC_EVERY_IDLE's default max(ENC_EVERY*6, 12), which is in turn SIG_LOOK's default.

levers.name: REKEY_EVERY
levers.effect: cadence of memory re-keying as the encoder improves; 0 disarms the rekey DID IT FIRE row.

levers.name: TEMP
levers.effect: InfoNCE softmax temperature ('logits = za @ zp.t() / TEMP').
levers.owner: registry says misc; is an encoder knob

levers.name: ENC_FUSE
levers.effect: encode anchor+positive in ONE pass; mathematically identical but not bit-identical (different reduction order).

levers.name: MANAGE_EVERY
levers.effect: expert-bank and world-model management cadence. Domains do NOT use it (they use DOM_MANAGE_EVERY).

levers.name: MANAGE_MERGE
levers.effect: domain consolidation distance. Non-zero OVERRIDES the MERGE_FRAC*NEW_DIST fallback; the default 0.28 equals that product exactly.

levers.name: FAB_NMAX
levers.effect: preallocated expert slot pool (hard ceiling); also MAX_DOMAINS' default, so it silently sets the domain cap too.

levers.name: MAX_DOMAINS
levers.effect: hard cap on the live domain population, defaulted to FAB_NMAX so the two dual populations stay tied.

levers.name: MERGE_FRAC
levers.effect: merge threshold as a fraction of NEW_DIST. Unreachable unless MANAGE_MERGE is explicitly 0.

levers.name: DOM_DECAY
levers.effect: per-manage decay of a domain's activity counter (ExpertRouter's rule).

levers.name: DOM_GRACE
levers.effect: minimum domain age before it may be culled.

levers.name: DOM_CULL_FRAC
levers.effect: per-manage cull budget: bottom fraction by DECAYED activity.

levers.name: DOM_CULL_FLOOR
levers.effect: refuse to cull a domain still holding a per-source floor's worth of memory; 0 reproduces the collapse-to-one-domain arm.

levers.name: DOM_WINS
levers.effect: reservoir of sample windows kept per domain; the basis for re-keying and for the measured acceptance radius.

levers.name: DOM_ADAPTIVE
levers.effect: calibrate the spawn threshold to measured within-domain scatter (censored median). OFF: measured worse than the constant it replaces.

levers.name: DOM_SPAWN_K
levers.effect: spawn only beyond median + K*MAD of recent assign distances. Only read when DOM_ADAPTIVE is on.

levers.name: DOM_RELATIVE
levers.effect: assign on the relative margin (scale-free) rather than an absolute distance. OFF: never validated end to end.

levers.name: DOM_MARGIN
levers.effect: re-identify when d(nearest) <= DOM_MARGIN * d(runner-up). Only meaningful under DOM_RELATIVE.

levers.name: SHIFT_REL
levers.effect: boundary test relative to the recent adjacent-distance scale instead of the constant SHIFT_DIST. OFF.

levers.name: SHIFT_Q
levers.effect: quantile of recent adjacent distances used as the relative base. Only under SHIFT_REL.

levers.name: SHIFT_MULT
levers.effect: trip when the jump is this many times the SHIFT_Q base. Only under SHIFT_REL.

levers.name: DOM_RADIUS
levers.effect: per-domain acceptance radius measured from that domain's own reservoir, instead of the global NEW_DIST constant. ON; one of the two changes that beat the constants on a controlled test.

levers.name: DOM_RQ
levers.effect: the quantile of d(reservoir window, own centroid) that defines the radius.

levers.name: DOM_RMULT
levers.effect: multiplier applied to that quantile.

levers.name: DOM_RCAP
levers.effect: Voronoi guard: radius <= DOM_RCAP x distance to the nearest other centroid. 0 removes the guard; >=1.5 measured indistinguishable from off.

levers.name: DOM_RECUR
levers.effect: fold domains that never RECUR into their nearest neighbour. ON; with the radius this is what made the domain count intensive rather than a log of splices.

levers.name: DOM_MIN_VISITS
levers.effect: 'recurs' means entered on at least this many SEPARATE occasions.

levers.name: DOM_RECUR_HORIZON
levers.effect: a domain is judged for recurrence only after this many BOUNDARIES since birth (not steps).

levers.name: DOM_FOLD_MULT
levers.effect: refuse to fold further than this multiple of the pooled radius; unguarded this collapses to one domain.

levers.name: DOM_MANAGE_EVERY
levers.effect: domain merge/cull/fold cadence, split off from MANAGE_EVERY because at 500 it fired zero or one times per run. Doubles as the ARMED predicate for three DID IT FIRE rows.

levers.name: DOM_PRIOR
levers.effect: blend weight of a per-domain token histogram into prediction at eval; 0 disables the accounting entirely.

levers.name: TOKC_DECAY
levers.effect: what a domain's token histogram keeps across a re-segmentation; 1.0 restores cumulative-forever counts.

levers.name: LOSS_MASK_DEAD
levers.effect: exclude never-minted ids from the softmax denominator; it is the enabling change that makes reserved VMAX headroom free, and GROW_CAP_VOCAB is only honest with it on.
levers.owner: tokenizer (as tagged) though filed in the domains block

levers.name: FAB_PRESS_SOFT
levers.effect: judge capacity pressure against the GROW_CAP soft cap instead of FAB_NMAX preallocation -- i.e. it changes what FAB_PRESSURE means.

levers.name: FAB_RESCUE
levers.effect: size of the mutation an expert gets INSTEAD of being culled the first time, in units of its own weight scale (same units as FAB_MUT). 0 = cull on first selection. Lives behind cull_gate_open.

levers.name: FAB_NEW_FRAC
levers.effect: cap on the fraction of the LIVE population born within the last FAB_NEW_WIN steps; 0 restores the uncapped ramp. Inert under FAB_GROW=0.

levers.name: FAB_NEW_WIN
levers.effect: the window the newborn-fraction is measured over; 0 (the declared default) silently means FAB_COOLDOWN.

levers.name: FAB_COOLDOWN
levers.effect: minimum steps between growth events; also the fallback value of FAB_NEW_WIN.

levers.name: GROW_CAP
levers.effect: master switch for both soft caps (fabric and vocabulary). OFF by default, so the whole earned-capacity valve is disarmed.

levers.name: GROW_CAP_FAB
levers.effect: under GROW_CAP, apply the soft cap to the expert population.

levers.name: GROW_CAP_VOCAB
levers.effect: under GROW_CAP, apply the soft cap to the vocabulary. Only honest with LOSS_MASK_DEAD=1, otherwise it measures the reservation.

levers.name: GROW_LIFT
levers.effect: fraction of the current cap handed out per earned lift (proportional, so it means the same at 160 and 4096).

levers.name: GROW_LIFT_MIN
levers.effect: absolute floor on a lift so a small cap still moves.

levers.name: GROW_CAP_PLATEAU
levers.effect: relative slow-loss improvement below which the run counts as stalled -- the second half of the pinned-AND-plateaued conjunction.

levers.name: GROW_CAP_EVERY
levers.effect: steps a cap must stay PINNED before a lift is earned; counted with pin_tick in real step deltas, not in flushes.

levers.name: MANAGE
levers.effect: master ablation switch for merge/cull across populations; 0 lets domains grow unbounded and disarms the fabric.cull DID IT FIRE row.

levers.name: DOM_CULL_EMPTY
levers.effect: cull a domain holding no memory and no windows immediately, without waiting for the act/stale conjunction it can fail forever.

levers.name: MANAGE_MIN
levers.effect: cull domains holding fewer than this many windows (when also stale).

levers.name: MANAGE_STALE
levers.effect: steps unseen before a small domain counts as stale.

levers.name: COMP_EMA
levers.effect: EMA rate for per-domain / per-node COMPETENCE (bits on the material it wins).
levers.owner: registry says misc; is a domains/fabric selection knob

levers.name: FAB_SPAWN
levers.effect: let the router specify a non-existent expert and decode it into being, so the LM loss backpropagates into q_route.

levers.name: FAB_AE_W
levers.effect: weight on the weights->identity->weights round trip that keeps the expert decoder honest.

levers.name: FAB_KEY_NORM
levers.effect: normalise the LEARNED routing term so it cannot swamp the grounded region term. Principled but UNVALIDATED.

levers.name: FAB_DISCOVER
levers.effect: cosine distance beyond which a signature is treated as unowned material and handed to the least-used expert; 0 disables discovery-by-novelty.

levers.name: FAB_REPLICATE
levers.effect: grow by cloning the fittest expert plus jitter rather than minting a blank identity that can never earn traffic.

levers.name: COMP_PROTECT
levers.effect: protect a unit that beats the population on its own material from culling however rarely used; 0 restores pure-utilization selection. Also the ARMED predicate for fabric.spare and fabric.failed_out.
levers.owner: registry says misc; is fabric/domains selection

levers.name: KEY_WIN
levers.effect: context window length used to build a memory key (KW); recorded in the checkpoint so a loader reproduces it.

levers.name: TOK_COMPOSE
levers.effect: token vector = composite(bytes) + learned residual. Gates construction of ByteComposer, and with it TOK_ANCHOR/TAU/USES and the whole no-warm-start story. Has NO effect on MODEL=transformer.

levers.name: TOK_ANCHOR
levers.effect: weight of the penalty holding a new token's residual near its composite. Never enters the loss when TOK_COMPOSE=0 (the default).

levers.name: TOK_ANCHOR_TAU
levers.effect: release horizon in STEPS of the token's own life. Unused whenever TOK_ANCHOR_USES > 0, which is the default.

levers.name: TOK_ANCHOR_USES
levers.effect: release horizon in APPEARANCES; >0 selects the appearances branch and makes the anchor independent of re-segmentation.

levers.name: TOK_MINT_PMIN
levers.effect: minimum p(b|a) required to allow a merge; 0 = mint on frequency alone. Mirrored onto TOK.pmin and also read inside DynamicTokenizer.__init__.

levers.name: TOKENIZER
levers.effect: master switch for subword mode (USE_TOK). TOKENIZER=1 REQUIRES DATA_MODE=real or the run exits at startup.

levers.name: TOK_ONLINE
levers.effect: mint during training (model sized to VMAX, corpora stay bytes) vs build a fixed vocabulary up front (corpora pre-tokenized, model sized to TOK.vocab_size). Selects SEED_VOCAB/SEED_PASSES vs VMAX/GROW_PASSES.

levers.name: SAVE_CKPT
levers.effect: checkpoint DIRECTORY. '0'/''/off/no/none/false all mean disabled. Also determines _TOK_SAVE (SAVE_CKPT + '.dyntok.json').

levers.name: RESUME
levers.effect: checkpoint to resume from (a directory, or a .pt file). Forces the tokenizer LOAD branch even under TOK_ONLINE, suppresses vocabulary saving when SAVE_CKPT is off, and supplies the sibling-tokenizer guess.

levers.name: TOKENIZER_PATH
levers.effect: the file the vocabulary is READ from. On a resume with it unset, <RESUME>.dyntok.json is preferred when it exists. The WRITE path is _TOK_SAVE, not this.

levers.name: SEED
levers.effect: seeds torch and python RNG at import, and is one of the two inputs to the stream generator _srng (SEED, epoch).

levers.name: TF32
levers.effect: enable TF32 for matmul and cuDNN; changes how matmuls execute, not what is computed.

levers.name: AMP
levers.effect: 'off' or 'bf16'; 'fp16' is refused with SystemExit because there is no GradScaler and the step is gated on ACCUM.

levers.name: DATA_MODE
levers.effect: 'real' (corpora on disk) or 'synthetic' (Markov processes). Gates the entire corpus/tokenizer block, and with it whether DISK_STREAM/SEG_CONTIG/VMAX/VAL_FRAC/SEG_LEN/CORP/DN exist at all. Compared case-sensitively.

levers.name: DOMAINS
levers.effect: comma-separated corpus names, index-aligned with CORP; sets NP after the 5000-byte filter, and hence SEG_CONTIG and the phase schedule. Names label every held-out score.

levers.name: DISK_STREAM
levers.effect: mmap the corpora so training data can exceed RAM; also the only thing that makes _resample draw fresh data per epoch, and the only path that reads VAL_CAP. Defined ONLY on the real-data path.

levers.name: CORPUS_CAP
levers.effect: bytes read per domain by open_corpus.

levers.name: DATA_DIR
levers.effect: root of train/<domain>/part*.txt; also where the _fetch_manifest.json shuffle check looks.

levers.name: VAL_FRAC
levers.effect: held-out TAIL fraction of each corpus, never sampled into the training stream. It is a sample only if the corpus was written unordered -- hence the manifest warning.

levers.name: VAL_CAP
levers.effect: cap on held-out bytes per corpus. Read only under DISK_STREAM; on the in-RAM path the tail is uncapped.
levers.owner: registry says misc; is a data knob

levers.name: VMAX
levers.effect: hard vocabulary ceiling: emb/head row count and the width of ByteComposer's residual tables. On a resume it is pushed into TOK.vmax so a full saved tokenizer can mint again. Read separately from the environment inside ByteComposer.

levers.name: SEED_VOCAB
levers.effect: target vocabulary for the pre-training seed passes under TOK_ONLINE. Not read when TOK_ONLINE=0. The seed loop breaks early on convergence, so this is a target, not the achieved size.

levers.name: SEED_PASSES
levers.effect: number of tally-and-mint passes for the online seed. Not read when TOK_ONLINE=0.

levers.name: GROW_PASSES
levers.effect: number of passes for the offline (TOK_ONLINE=0) expanding build. Never read at the default configuration.

levers.name: MIN_PAIR
levers.effect: minimum pair count before a merge is a candidate. Read only on the fresh-construction branch; a loaded tokenizer keeps the json's value.

levers.name: MAX_TOK
levers.effect: maximum token length in bytes for the tokenizer. ByteComposer's maxb is hardcoded at 16 and does not follow it. Read only on the fresh-construction branch.

levers.name: TOK_DROPOUT
levers.effect: BPE-dropout probability during segmentation. Read only on the fresh-construction branch.

levers.name: TOK_MINT_GATE_K
levers.effect: how far down the candidate ranking the predictability gate may look. Mirrored onto TOK.gate_k and also read in DynamicTokenizer.__init__. Measured: at 64 the window itself starved minting.

levers.name: TOK_GROW_CAP
levers.effect: bytes taken from the head of each corpus for the tokenizer's seed/grow passes.

levers.name: SEG_CONTIG
levers.effect: read each corpus in order (only text-intrinsic boundaries) instead of seeking to a random offset every segment. Default 1 when exactly one corpus survives the filter.

levers.name: PHASED
levers.effect: non-stationary stream: processes ENTER and FADE per phase. 0 is the stationary ablation and leaves PH_BOUNDS empty.

levers.name: PHASES
levers.effect: number of phases in the generated schedule; clamped up to a minimum of 2.

levers.name: PHASE_W
levers.effect: how many processes are live at a time. Default (n+1)//2 where n is the PROCESS count, clamped to at most n-1 so something can always fade.

levers.name: PHASE_SCHED
levers.effect: explicit pipe-separated schedule overriding the generator; validated at startup for empty phases and out-of-range ids.

levers.name: SEG_MIN
levers.effect: minimum segment length drawn per splice; each segment start is recorded as a 'true switch'.
levers.owner: registry says domains; is a data/stream knob

levers.name: SEG_MAX
levers.effect: maximum segment length drawn per splice.
levers.owner: registry says domains; is a data/stream knob

levers.name: MODEL
levers.effect: 'gru' (MiniLM) or 'transformer' (TinyTransformer). Sets LAYERS' default (1 vs 4) and decides whether ByteComposer exists at all.

levers.name: DROPOUT
levers.effect: dropout on embeddings and GRU hidden states (multi-layer only for the inter-layer dropout). Default OFF because the model is underfit.

levers.name: ENC_VREG
levers.effect: VICReg-style variance hinge on the encoder, scaled by sqrt(SIG_D) because the outputs are L2-normalised. ON by default; it is the anti-collapse term for single-corpus material.

levers.name: ENC_CREG
levers.effect: covariance term of the same regulariser; 0 by default.

levers.name: WEIGHT_DECAY
levers.effect: AdamW weight decay. Default OFF because the model is underfit.

carry_forward.item: The registry is the declaration and every call site is a use: _env raises SystemExit when a call-site default differs from _SPEC. Only _SPEC_FREE (== set(_DERIVED), 9 knobs) is exempt, and levers.py re-derives both sets from the AST and fails on drift. Any rebuild must keep this contract or the five-knobs-with-two-defaults failure returns.
carry_forward.why: VMAX once sized one tensor for 4096 and another for 2048; DOMAINS was read with default '' in the checkpoint path, keying report_holdout on an empty domain list

carry_forward.item: The audit reader must NOT be the ordinary reader. _cfg reads _SPEC directly and deliberately does not enter _ENV_READ; routing it through _env would make the 'nothing read this' audit think a knob is live merely because the report looked at it. And _cfg must never restate a default.
carry_forward.why: an earlier version of _cfg guessed FAB_RESCUE=0.35 against a declared 0.0 and killed the run at the report

carry_forward.item: Any clock compared against a knob written in STEPS must be advanced by a step delta, not by one per call, whenever it lives below the BATCH_W flush early-out.
carry_forward.why: GROW_CAP_EVERY=20000 silently meant 320,000 steps at BATCH_W=16; the population sat pinned for 43,645 real steps while the clock read 2,650

carry_forward.item: Diagnostics must not move the run: wrap every probe in frozen_rng/@no_rng_drift, and give the STREAM its own generator seeded from (SEED, epoch) only.
carry_forward.why: build_stream draws segment lengths and seg_from turns a length into a read cursor, so two arms differing only in a probation threshold read DIFFERENT TEXT from epoch 2 onward; every single-knob A/B was partly a data difference

carry_forward.item: PH_BOUNDS must be CLEARED at the top of each build_stream, not appended to. It is read as 'sum(1 for b in PH_BOUNDS if bpos >= b) - 1'.
carry_forward.why: accumulating gave 4 entries per epoch, so by epoch 3 that index read 8 for a position whose phase was 2 -- PHASED=1 would have failed in exactly the multi-epoch configuration it exists for

carry_forward.item: DN and CORP are index-aligned and any filter must drop from BOTH. Name-keying a probe does not save you, because the name is itself read out of the possibly-desynchronised list.
carry_forward.why: with DOMAINS='eng,py' and an undersized eng corpus, VALC[0] was the PYTHON corpus and report_holdout named it 'eng'; the next run then compared this run's Python against the last run's English and reported the difference as forgetting

carry_forward.item: A checkpoint's vocabulary is part of the checkpoint. TOKENIZER_PATH is the READ path; the WRITE path must be derived from SAVE_CKPT (_TOK_SAVE), and a resume with no checkpoint of its own must write no vocabulary at all.
carry_forward.why: both save sites once wrote back through TOKENIZER_PATH, so a run that minted anything overwrote its parent's vocabulary and the NEXT resume from the same parent died on a vocabulary mismatch that the previous run had created

carry_forward.item: A saved tokenizer carries its OWN vmax, min_pair, max_tok and dropout in the json. On a resume only vmax is corrected from the environment; the other three are silently the parent's.
carry_forward.why: a tokenizer saved full at 2048 comes back full at 2048 and refuses every candidate before one is even formed -- DID IT FIRE reported 'ZERO tokenizer.mint / ZERO tokenizer.mint_reject ARMED AND INERT' on the first run that ever added an area to a trained system

carry_forward.item: FAB_NMAX and VMAX are preallocated-and-counter-advanced geometries, so a smaller checkpoint is a genuine PREFIX of a larger live tensor. Widening on resume is the point; narrowing must be refused by the knob's name.
carry_forward.why: the run that motivated widen_prefix had both ceilings pressed: the cull opened immediately at 523/1024 while a new language arrived, and the vocabulary was full at 2048/2048 so the new language got zero tokens of its own

carry_forward.item: cull_gate_open (n_live/cap >= FAB_PRESSURE, with an n_live<=2 floor) hides THREE mechanisms behind it: the utilization cull, the utilization spare, and FAB_RESCUE. Any change to FAB_PRESSURE, FAB_N0, FAB_NMAX or FAB_PRESS_SOFT changes whether all three run at all.
carry_forward.why: FAB_N0=2048 against FAB_NMAX=4096 parked occupancy at 0.50 below a FAB_PRESSURE of 0.75 and fabric.spare read ARMED AND INERT for a whole investigation; at 0.45 the same code produced 204 utilization culls and 1253 spares against 0 and 0

carry_forward.item: ENC_WARMUP_MIN must be strictly below ENC_WARMUP; the code takes min(ENC_WARMUP_MIN, ENC_WARMUP), so an inverted pair collapses the floor onto the full warmup and the adaptive early stop can never fire.
carry_forward.why: 3000 against ENC_WARMUP=800 was the shipped default state; every launcher happened to pass a valid pair, so only default-configured runs were affected and nothing measured caught it

carry_forward.item: Every subsystem now defaults ON; 'off' is the deliberate ablation. The exceptions are exceptions for stated reasons: EXPERTS is mutually exclusive with FABRIC (the forward pass is an elif chain and FABRIC wins), DISK_STREAM is a data-source choice, and DOM_ADAPTIVE/DOM_RELATIVE/SHIFT_REL each measured WORSE than the constant they replace.
carry_forward.why: an audit found six subsystems silently defaulting off, so the 'full system' being measured was the base LM plus memory plus domains and nothing else

carry_forward.item: MANAGE_MERGE is a POLICY knob, not a correctness one: `did` is consumed only by mem.src provenance, dom_exp reporting and the clustering report -- routing uses the continuous gist, so the domain COUNT sets the granularity of FORGETTING, not prediction quality. Never read the domain count without purity and homogeneity beside it; 0.80 also reaches '4 domains' with purity 0.71.
carry_forward.why: 0.45 maximises V-measure against four SEEDED corpora, which is a reconstruction score against a scaffold we spliced in; 0.28 = MERGE_FRAC*NEW_DIST restores create/consolidate consistency without forcing the population to the seeded count

carry_forward.item: Domain management needs its OWN cadence. At the shared MANAGE_EVERY=500 a 60 kB run (468 steps) never satisfied step % 500 == 0 and merge/cull/fold executed ZERO times; every domain-population number the project reported was produced with the consolidation half switched off by arithmetic.
carry_forward.why: the same modulo-cadence class of fault has produced multiple published conclusions about code paths that never ran

carry_forward.item: The default configuration is not runnable (TOKENIZER=1 + DATA_MODE=synthetic exit at startup), and the synthetic path is structurally under-tested: selftest.sh trains on real data, and preflight.sh's end-to-end smoke -- the only thing that sets DATA_MODE=synthetic -- is the one instrument aimed at a fresh box.
carry_forward.why: a VALC NameError on every synthetic run since 2026-08-15 was reported as 'self_organize.py FAILED on CUDA', an architecture problem it had nothing to do with; DISK_STREAM is the same defect still present
carry_forward.evidence: self_organize.py:1103-1119; verified undefined-globals probe on the synthetic path

carry_forward.item: The held-out tail is a SAMPLE only if the corpus was written unordered. Corpora written in arrival order put a contiguous block of whichever documents came last on the held-out side, and the headline becomes a measurement of that block.
carry_forward.why: measured: the-stack Python held out at 5.061 +/- 0.560 against 2.922 in-stream, while shuffled fineweb-edu English was 2.273 against 2.303 -- the gap was the ordering

carry_forward.item: bwt_of's sign runs opposite to the accuracy literature (negative = old domains IMPROVED) because the metric is bits/byte, and forgetting_of clips at zero so improvement cannot cancel a real regression.
carry_forward.why: selftest.sh only ever checked that the words 'BWT' and 'negative = old domains IMPROVED' appear in the log, so reversing the subtraction would pass every assertion while inverting the project's headline continual-learning claim

carry_forward.item: Collapse a per-process learning curve by averaging over ACTIVE processes at each step, never by keying a dict on the step alone.
carry_forward.why: the old expression kept whichever process was appended last -- always the highest-indexed, i.e. under the add-an-area schedule the NEWEST corpus, the one that cannot have been forgotten. Every 'is it still learning' sentence one CL run printed was about Python only. Absent windows must also be excluded: py went 2.51 ACTIVE to 4.64 ABSENT, a +2.13 b/B step into a test whose threshold is 0.5
